# A twilight cloud: five flattened faceted lumps, 3.6 m wide, 1.2 m tall. A game bone: the game
# drifts it across the sky.
new
material new Cloud --base-color 0.9333 0.5255 0.5843 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name C0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.8 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.3 0.7 0.8
apply --scale
set location 0 0 0.1
apply --location
add mesh ico-sphere --name C1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.6 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.3 0.7 0.8
apply --scale
set location -0.9 0 -0.1
apply --location
add mesh ico-sphere --name C2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.65 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.3 0.7 0.8
apply --scale
set location 0.95 0 -0.05
apply --location
add mesh ico-sphere --name C3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.55 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.3 0.7 0.8
apply --scale
set location -0.35 0 0.45
apply --location
add mesh ico-sphere --name C4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.3 0.7 0.8
apply --scale
set location 0.45 0 0.4
apply --location
select all
material assign Cloud
active C0
join
rename C0 Cloud
select all
shade flat
export cloud.glb
